text:
Dude, you have to see this place! We walked through a hole in the fence near that old stadium. It’s totally creepy but also super cool. There’s this giant swimming pool, like, the biggest I’ve ever seen, but it’s completely empty. No water at all! Just dry concrete tiles stretching out forever.

It’s winter now, so there are these weird white patches on the bottom that look like snow, but Mom said it’s probably just frost or something. The wind makes a funny whistling noise when it blows across the empty lanes. You can actually hear your own footsteps echoing really loud. It’s like standing inside a giant cave made of blue tiles.

Twenty years ago, people were splashing around here winning gold medals. Now? Just us and some dead leaves blowing in circles. It feels like we’re explorers finding an ancient temple, except this temple is for fish who forgot how to swim. Can we come back next time?
